name: Heart of a Spy
source:
When your superior and ex-lover gives you an assignment to seduce another man, you have to do what you do best. You may look like a nice and meek college senior, but your skills are one of a kind, and your reputation is well-earned! Steal some secrets with your kisses!

[From in-app]
